audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Ki Burst as the one cooldown to track. The actual punish window is Broken Wings: all three casts share a single 13-second cooldown, so once the third cast is spent she has no mobility at all.
audit.why: Riot text, Riven Q Broken Wings (cooldown 13, range 275): 'Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.' One 13s timer covers the whole chain. Valor (E) is 10/9/8/7/6s. Ki Burst (W) is 11/10/9/8/7s at only 260 range.
audit.corrected: Count her Q casts. Third cast spent plus Valor down is a Riven who cannot leave — that is the Body Slam window, not merely 'Ki Burst is down'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Valor's shield is never distinguished from a displacement immunity.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.' It blocks damage only — Explosive Cask's knockback still moves her, so the Cask works as a repositioning tool even into a shielded Riven.
audit.corrected: Valor blocks the damage, not the knockback — Cask her into your tower regardless of her shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommends 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern', and breakdown.late says 'anti-heal stays core'. Riven has no healing.
audit.why: None of Riven's five abilities in Riot's text heals: Runic Blade charges her autos, Broken Wings is damage plus knockback, Ki Burst is damage plus stun, Valor is a dash plus damage block, Blade of the Exile is AD, range and Wind Slash. Buying Grievous Wounds into her is wasted gold, and the male pronoun gives away that this is boilerplate.
audit.corrected: Drop anti-heal; her damage is physical, so armour and Plated Steelcaps are the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven level-chart sides contradicted the packet chart and their own why text.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Skill. Stored sides were Skill, Riven, Riven, Skill, Skill, Riven, Riven — yet whys[1] says 'W comes online... out-sustains her early poke', whys[3] 'W max and Happy Hour let you out-sustain her poke and win extended trades', whys[4] 'your hardest all-in', whys[5] 'outpaces her Eclipse all-in'. Those are Gragas stages marked for Riven.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Skill in both layers, with ratings moved to match, as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty 6/10 against a 53.65% Emerald+ win rate over 520 games with Gragas holding four of seven stages.
audit.why: Riven is a threat in open ground late, which the 8/10 carry rating already carries; the lane itself is favourable for Gragas.
audit.corrected: Difficulty set to 5/10, carry threat left at 8/10.

audit.why: The packet flags 'Hold Explosive Cask' in wants.you[2] as a probable wrong ability name at distance 5. It is a false positive — Explosive Cask is Gragas's real R name and 'Hold' is just the verb. No edit made.

edits.after: Yours now: W max and Happy Hour win the extended trade — bait the Valor shield, then commit E-W-Q while her whole Q chain is down.

notes: Biggest single find: report[8] told the player to buy Executioner's Calling into a champion with zero healing in her kit, and breakdown.late repeated 'anti-heal stays core'. Both removed — that is wasted gold on every game. The other structural fix is reframing the tracked cooldown from Ki Burst to Broken Wings: all three Q casts share one 13-second timer, so 'third cast spent' is the real commit signal and it is far easier to read than a hidden W timer. Level chart was inverted in six of seven rows against the packet and against the content layer's own whys. The packet's suspectName flag on wants.you[2] ('Hold Explosive Cask') is a false positive and was left alone.
